title: Spooky2 Rife Frequency List — structured publisher claims
scope: All frequency-table entries on PDF pages 5–19; this is a selected list, not the complete Spooky2 software database.
boundary: Publisher associations are not measured elemental spectra or evidence of therapeutic efficacy. No clinical dose or treatment protocol is inferred.

publisher_database_definitions.PROV: Publisher-designated consistent-results category; not independently proven.
publisher_database_definitions.BIO: Publisher attributes to Russian frequency research.
publisher_database_definitions.VEGA: Publisher attributes to Russian frequency research.
publisher_database_definitions.CAFL: Consolidated Annotated Frequency List; experimenter compilation.
publisher_database_definitions.RIFE: Publisher attributes to Royal Raymond Rife.
publisher_database_definitions.ETDFL: Publisher attributes to German bioresonance clinics.
publisher_database_definitions.KHZ: Higher-frequency collection; not a unit specification.
publisher_database_definitions.ODD: UNKNOWN: appears in a row but is not defined in the introduction.

element_reference_links.note: Zinc label only; chemical species/state/mechanism unknown. Not an atomic resonance measurement.

context_note: Descriptions on pages 20–24 are commercial claims. Remote DNA/quantum explanations and broad cancer/pathogen efficacy claims are not adopted as established physics or medicine.
